form.url-helptext: URL of OpenProject installation (including context path).
form.apiToken-helptext: An API token for OpenProject; This can be created for a user in OpenProject under 'Account settings' → 'Access tokens' in the 'API' section.
form.autoClose-helptext: Enables the state changes function. SCM-Manager searches for issue keys and issue status keywords in commit messages and pull requests. If both are found in a text, SCM-Manager changes the state of the issue in OpenProject.
form.disableStateChangeByCommit: Disable issue state changes by commits
form.disableStateChangeByCommit-helptext: Disables the state changes by commits. If this is activated, only pull requests will trigger state changes.
form.updateIssues-helptext: Enable the automatic update function. SCM-Manager searches for issue keys in commit messages and pull requests. If an issue id is found, SCM-Manager updates the issue with a comment.
form.disableRepositoryConfiguration-helptext: Do not allow repository owners to configure OpenProject instances.

mapping.title: OpenProject Status Mapping
mapping.help: Map keywords to OpenProject status in order to trigger state changes with those keywords.
mapping.statusHelp: Name of OpenProject status which should be mapped e.g.: Closed
mapping.keywordsHelp: Comma separated list of keywords which are mapped to the OpenProject status e.g.: closes, closing
